# AiKOVA Receptionist

> AI receptionist for UK, Europe and Africa. Answers phone and WhatsApp, books appointments, sends payment links. Try before register.

## Summary
AiKOVA (ai-receptionist.aikova.co.uk) is a multilingual AI receptionist for local businesses (restaurants, clinics, salons, retail, professional services). It handles voice and messaging, bookings, FAQs and payments (Stripe UK/EU; Paystack/M-Pesa Africa). GDPR-ready in UK/EU; NDPR-ready in Africa. Public try desk at /try needs no account.
